description: The public, unauthenticated registration endpoint accepts a 'role' field in the request body and assigns it outright. Including "role": "admin" alongside the normal email/password/passwordRepeat fields creates a genuine admin account, no exploit beyond one extra field in a public signup form, no prior authentication of any kind. Confirmed by Juice Shop's own 'Admin Registration' scoreboard entry, which solves on exactly this condition.
expected_exploit_indicator: The newly registered account's own JWT, obtained by logging in immediately after, decodes to data.role == 'admin'
expected_blocked_signal: The created account's role is 'customer' regardless of what the registration body claimed
legitimate_check: A normal registration with no role field at all must still default to 'customer' in every condition.
